note: The audio feed of a station that Tuner plays.
The online catalogue of stations (radio-browser) that Tuner connects to.
To mark a station as a favourite. Unstar reverses it. Related: Starred.
A track the user marked with a heart while it played.
To mark the playing track as a favourite. The ♥ symbol is kept.
The list of hearted tracks kept permanently, across sessions.
The title, artist and other details a station sends about what it is playing.
Data sent with a stream, such as the track title and images. Related: Stream Metadata.
Offer a station's stream address to others, as text or a QR code.
